title: Add a docs link checker that resolves relative .md links and #anchors against GitHub heading slugs
outcome: TermAl has a small script under scripts/ that a focused launcher run can execute. It checks that every relative markdown link in docs/ resolves: the target file exists and the #anchor matches a heading slug as GitHub renders it, underscores kept. Docs-only changes then have a real registered check.
acceptance: A script under scripts/ resolves every relative link in docs/**/*.md to an existing file and, for a #fragment, to a heading whose GitHub slug equals the fragment. It exits non-zero with the file, line and link for each unresolved one.

Behavioural tests use fixture markdown the test creates itself (never the repository's own docs or agent instruction files). They cover a resolving link, a missing file, a missing anchor, an underscore-and-punctuation slug, and duplicate-heading suffixes.
It runs on current master with zero unresolved links, or each pre-existing broken link is fixed or filed. docs/test.md names the focused command.
